# PLAN — iteration 4
## Current state assessment

Iteration 2 is the accepted incumbent, with WNS −2.962 ns; iteration 3’s symmetric coefficient branch worsened WNS to −3.856 ns and was rejected. The seed already has a balanced adder tree with DSP use disabled on its sums, so the next candidate should change the summation structure. The top’s authoritative latency is 1 cycle, requiring `// @latency 1`; timing remains infeasible until both setup WNS and hold WHS are nonnegative.

## Hypothesis

Compressing the eight 32-bit products with a carry-save tree before one final carry-propagate addition should reduce serial carry-chain depth and improve setup WNS, at the cost of additional LUT logic.

## Instruction for generator

Keep the delay line, signed parameterized products, output register, synchronous reset behavior, interface, and `// @latency 1` unchanged. Replace the pairwise `s01` through `sum_all` adder tree with a 32-bit carry-save compressor tree over `p0` through `p7`, followed by a single final 32-bit addition into `y_out`. Preserve modulo-2³² sum behavior for every supported signed coefficient value, and avoid the previously rejected symmetric-coefficient pre-add architecture. Expect more LUTs but fewer serial carry-propagate stages; retain the candidate only if fixed simulation and implementation gates pass and it improves timing under the promotion rules.
